identity.display_name: 天庭 UI 与无障碍信息架构合同

source_contracts.role: 预警、决策、反制、可见结果与双通道可读性要求
权威进度、会话成员、轮换快照、资格、恢复、清理与完成边界
七星与四圣称号的离线展示关系与集合替代语义
收藏和奖励均不能由 UI 生成、推算或承诺的经济隔离边界

global_boundaries.authority_display_rule: UI only renders future authority-accepted facts. Missing, stale, mismatched or unavailable facts must remain unconfirmed and cannot be inferred from client cache, party leadership, local clock, animation or visual effects.
global_boundaries.dual_channel_rule: Every critical warning requires at least two independent expressions. Color is never the sole carrier for direction, danger, ownership, counterplay, chain state or terminal result.
global_boundaries.request_result_separation_rule: A local click, animation completion, local timer or panel refresh never becomes progression, admission, session, cleanup, qualification, collection, reward or settlement success.
global_boundaries.economy_rule: No panel creates, selects or submits source_profile, reward_slot_key, owner, qualification, roll, pity, receipt, currency, material, XP, drop, reward or settlement data.
global_boundaries.protected_difu_key_rule: DF_PROGRESS_YANLUO_HALL_CLEARED is never read, written, displayed as a TianTing prerequisite or substituted for the trusted handoff proof.

acceptance.rule: Artifact remains an offline information architecture contract and contains no Y3 UI JSON, Lua, runtime control tree or state machine.
All runtime, UI node, asset, icon, sound, effect, text-template, event and save identifiers remain null.
Missing, stale or mismatched authority facts remain unconfirmed and are never inferred locally.
Each critical warning has dual-channel expression.
Color is never the sole carrier for direction, danger, ownership, counterplay, chain state or result.
Combat display never writes progression, membership, chain, session, qualification, cleanup or economy facts.
Failure review remains understandable as a warning-decision-counterplay chain.
Current mansion rotation facts read only one immutable authority snapshot.
Client clock, timezone, retry, reconnect and UI refresh cannot calculate or mutate rotation.
Created instances state their locked snapshot, while uncreated instances do not impersonate live instance facts.
Team display reads authority-frozen membership and accepted member state only.
A left member receives no UI route for reconnect, proxy claim, make-up claim or current-instance completion.
Cleanup-pending state cannot be unlocked or bypassed by UI.
Nightmare qualification remains per-member and cannot be replaced by leader, teammate, client record or client-selected quadrant.
Admission feedback exposes only non-sensitive result and reason categories.
Review presentation never grants retry, reward, settlement or terminal-session authority.
Accepted normal completion remains visible as accepted even if cleanup acknowledgement is pending, delayed or failed.
Failure, completion and review views do not display or promise rewards, values, drops, currency, XP, pity or receipts.
Without future authority collection facts, seven-star ownership, exchange and unlock state stay unconfirmed.
Seven-star aggregate title is presented as replacing, not stacking with, individual-title effect sets.
Officer pressure, sacred-beast protection and accepted purified-chain state are separately readable.
Four-sacred aggregate title is presented as replacing, not stacking with, directional-title effect sets.
UI never creates or submits economy input, qualification, receipt or settlement data.
Protected Difu progression key is never consumed, written or presented as a TianTing prerequisite.
